brief.title: Harborview Clinics: renewal and adoption plan
brief.mission: Explore renewal and adoption plan, validate the facts, and agree a practical next step.
brief.successLooksLike: A specific evidence-based next step with an owner and timing.

content.subject: Next steps on renewal and adoption plan

messages.body:
Alex,
We should discuss low staff adoption after onboarding. Please bring a concrete plan and do not assume our team can take on extra work this month.

Owen Brooks
Customer Success Director | Harborview Clinics

keyMoments.idealMove: Ask how low staff adoption after onboarding is measured and who is affected.
keyMoments.why: The contact needs a plan tied to a real operational constraint.

keyMoments.idealMove: Ask which count is current: 75 seats or 72 seats.
keyMoments.why: The account note and recent operations note disagree.

keyMoments.idealMove: Confirm the documented term: The renewal date is June 30 and a 30-day notice is required.
keyMoments.why: An unsupported commitment could harm the customer relationship.

keyMoments.idealMove: Propose a short follow-up with an owner and a concrete agenda.
keyMoments.why: The contact has limited capacity and needs a credible plan.
